description: Find device drivers in the catalogue of synths, drum machines, controllers and DAWs. Without arguments it lists them all; `query` keeps drivers whose vendor, name or OSC prefix contain every word (e.g. 'korg minilogue'). Returns device (the catalogue id), name, vendor, OSC prefix, kind, source tier and firmware version when the source states one. Pass device to list_routes for the full CC/NRPN/SysEx map.

kind.description: Only the devices of this kind: hardware or software.

limit.description: Return at most this many drivers.

offset.description: Skip this many devices; a truncated answer says the offset that asks for the next ones.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the vendor, name or OSC prefix (case-insensitive).

user_id.description: Your anonymous SyntHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

name: list_devices

device.description: The device: its catalogue id, e.g. 'korg/minilogue'. Pass it as it is to list_routes and the other tools.

firmware.description: Firmware the source documents; null when it does not say.

osc_prefix.description: OSC prefix without the leading slash.

usage_status.description: Hosted server only: trust from usage reports (see get_trust).

nearby.description: Given when nothing is found and the query names a maker of the catalogue: its closest sheets, at most five.

remaining.description: How many devices found are beyond this answer (without limit, the answer holds as many as fit in 32 KiB).
